user.title: Server connection
user.description: Enter the DOODS2 base URL and API key if one is configured on the server. DOOODS checks the detector list and automatically chooses the first detector that supports the person label.

data_description.url: Use the app's internal hostname and port, for example http://addon-hostname:8080. Do not add /detect.
data_description.auth_key: The key is stored in Home Assistant settings and sent to the server only in the doods-auth-key header. It is never added to a URL or sent to the browser.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Choose cameras. Set each camera’s periodic scan interval, Recognition switch, Stream processing switch, and motion sensor in that camera device’s Settings section. Recognition off disables all scans. When Stream processing is on and supported, the RTSP motion gate takes priority over the selected HA motion sensor. By default, a working HA sensor is preferred; the RTSP gate defaults on when no usable sensor is available.

data_description.source: Select one or more camera entities. Configure each camera’s own interval, recognition, RTSP motion gate, and motion sensor in its device Settings. When enabled and supported, the RTSP gate takes priority over HA motion; without an explicit switch choice, a working HA sensor is preferred and RTSP is enabled by default when no usable sensor is available. A separate profile is created for each selected camera when supported; edit its zones in the DOOODS panel.

output.title: Annotated frame archive
output.description: Only frames with at least one detection that passes the active filters are stored. Leave the directory empty to disable the archive.

data.archive_max_age_days: Maximum frame age in days (0 = unlimited)

data_description.file_out: Enter one archive root directory. Relative paths are resolved under the Home Assistant configuration directory. DOOODS creates entry, camera, and date subdirectories and writes uniquely named JPEG files. Previous multi-line path templates were not used; replace them with a single directory. Cleanup only touches files created inside this entry archive. Changing or clearing the directory does not delete an older archive.
data_description.archive_max_count: When a new frame is stored, the oldest files for that camera are removed until the count is within this limit.
data_description.archive_max_age_days: Expired files are cleaned on startup, daily, and when frames are stored. If both limits are set, exceeding either one removes the file.

reconfigure.title: Change DOOODS connection settings
reconfigure.description: Update the saved URL or API key. DOOODS checks GET /detectors and requires at least one configured detector before saving.

data_description.url: Use the app's internal hostname and port, for example http://addon-hostname:8080. Do not add /detect.
data_description.auth_key: The current value is shown as a masked field. Saving an empty value clears the key. A matching API key is required for protected features, including profiles, previews, and RTSP motion streaming.

init.title: Cameras
init.description: Choose cameras. Set each camera’s periodic scan interval in that camera device’s Settings section; cameras without a saved value use 30 seconds. Each selected camera keeps its own profile on servers that support profiles. Configure each camera’s recognition, RTSP stream processing, and motion sensor in its device Settings. A working HA motion sensor is the default; when Stream processing is explicitly enabled and supported, the RTSP gate takes priority.

data_description.source: Select the cameras to scan. Configure each camera’s own interval, recognition, RTSP motion gate, and motion sensor in its device Settings. A working HA motion sensor is preferred by default; if it is unavailable, RTSP processing defaults on when supported. An enabled RTSP gate takes priority over HA motion. A separate profile is ensured for each selected camera when supported.

settings.title: Detector and archive settings
settings.description: Choose the detector and configure the archive and shared detection area. Timeout and confidence are managed by integration defaults. Configure each camera’s recognition, RTSP stream processing, and motion sensor in that camera device’s Settings section. If enabled and supported, RTSP motion processing takes priority over the selected HA motion sensor.

data.archive_max_age_days: Maximum frame age in days (0 = unlimited)

data_description.detector: Select a detector reported by DOOODS2. If the server is unavailable, the saved detector name can be edited manually.
data_description.file_out: Enter one archive root directory. Relative paths are resolved under the Home Assistant configuration directory. DOOODS creates entry, camera, and date subdirectories and writes uniquely named JPEG files. Previous multi-line path templates were not used; replace them with a single directory. Cleanup only touches files created inside this entry archive. Changing or clearing the directory does not delete an older archive.
data_description.archive_max_count: When a new frame is stored, the oldest files for that camera are removed until the count is within this limit.
data_description.archive_max_age_days: Expired files are cleaned on startup, daily, and when frames are stored. If both limits are set, exceeding either one removes the file.

area.name: Global detection area
area.description: The defaults cover the full image.

data.covers: Require each detection to fit fully inside the area

data_description.covers: When disabled, any overlap with the area is enough.
